business.description: Aban Offshore Ltd., headquartered in Chennai, is a leading Indian multinational specialising in offshore drilling services. The Company provides top-tier drilling and oil field solutions for offshore hydrocarbon exploration and production, serving domestic and international oil industries.

outlook.statement: The Company will continue to look for deploying its Rig with large Oil Exploration companies. The Company will continue to negotiate with the lenders to restructure its liabilities and reduce debts which will enhance the stakeholder value.

Opportunity for the Company is through adoption of advanced technologies to improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance sustainability. Threats: Geopolitical tensions in key oil-producing regions and oil price fluctuations are creating risks for operations and supply chains.

The Management believes that the use of the going concern assumption in the preparation of the financial statements for the financial year ended 31st March 2026 is still appropriate. The Management is in discussions with its lenders to obtain approval for implementation of an appropriate debt resolution plan.

There exists material uncertainty as on the date of the audit report with respect to the company's capacity of meeting its liabilities existing at the balance sheet date as and when they fall due within a period of one year from the date of the balance sheet.
outlook.period: one year from balance sheet date
